mapper.select: SELECT id, rule_code, name, category, sub_category, protocol, port, banner_regex, vendor, product, version_expr, confidence, description, enabled, priority, created_at, updated_at FROM asset_fingerprint_rule WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY priority ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, rule_code, name, category, sub_category, protocol, port, banner_regex, vendor, product, version_expr, confidence, description, enabled, priority, created_at, updated_at FROM asset_fingerprint_rule WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, rule_code, name, category, sub_category, protocol, port, banner_regex, vendor, product, version_expr, confidence, description, enabled, priority, created_at, updated_at FROM asset_fingerprint_rule WHERE rule_code = #{ruleCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_fingerprint_rule (rule_code, name, category, sub_category, protocol, port, banner_regex, vendor, product, version_expr, confidence, description, enabled, priority) VALUES (#{ruleCode}, #{name}, #{category}, #{subCategory}, #{protocol}, #{port}, #{bannerRegex}, #{vendor}, #{product}, #{versionExpr}, #{confidence}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{priority})
mapper.update: UPDATE asset_fingerprint_rule SET name = #{name}, category = #{category}, sub_category = #{subCategory}, protocol = #{protocol}, port = #{port}, banner_regex = #{bannerRegex}, vendor = #{vendor}, product = #{product}, version_expr = #{versionExpr}, confidence = #{confidence}, description = #{description}, enabled = #{enabled}, priority = #{priority} WHERE id = #{id}
